chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text:
This document defines the functional and system enhancement requirements for the Purchase Order from Buyer (OC) process.
The objective of this enhancement is to:
1. Enable Shipment Sample tagging at Additional Quantity level in OC.
2. Automate visibility of CWT OC Number (CA Number) across Kiara transactions and reports.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
• Shipment Sample Tagging in OC/CA
Shipment Samples are produced along with the bulk order. For the production of Shipment Samples, no additional material requirement is generated, as the required input materials are consumed from the bulk order allocation.
Shipment Sample quantity is recorded separately in the Material Liquidation Report by the CWT team. Therefore, the Shipment Sample quantity must be identifiable and traceable against the respective OC Number (CA) for reporting and reconciliation purposes.
• CWT OC Number handling in Kiara:
As per the current business process, both CWT and Kiara teams operate using the same CA (OC) number across all operational transactions and reports.
For example, when a fabric purchase order is created by the CWT team, it carries the CWT OC number. Upon dispatch, the supplier tags the same CWT OC number on the fabric rolls. The Kiara warehouse team verifies and matches the OC number on the received rolls with the corresponding purchase order.
Therefore, it is essential that Kiara continues to use and reflect the same OC number across all transactions and reporting to ensure consistency, traceability, and operational alignment.

chunks.title: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.heading: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.text: • This change will not impact any other existing functionalities.

chunks.title: Shipment sample type order tagging required on Additional Qty.
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirements › Shipment sample type order tagging required on Additional Qty.
chunks.text:
To meet the business requirement of restricting material requirement generation for additional quantities, the system already provides a BOM-level setting:
“Exclude Additional Production quantities in the MRL Generation.”
While this setting controls MRL behavior, there is currently no classification mechanism to identify the type of additional quantity.
Therefore, the following enhancement is required:
• Introduce an “Order Type” dropdown field at the Additional Quantity Breakup.
• The field shall allow users to categorize additional quantities appropriately.
Order Type Dropdown Values:
• Shipment Sample
• Extra Production: Required to distinguish whether the additional quantity is for Shipment Sample production or for extra production requirements
Order type requirement dropdown field screenshot
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirements › Shipment sample type order tagging required on Additional Qty.

chunks.title: CWT OC Number handling in Kiara
chunks.heading: Section 3. Functional Requirements › CWT OC Number handling in Kiara
chunks.text:
Requirement Description:
Both CWT and Kiara teams operate using the same OC (CA) number across all operational transactions and reports. For visibility and internal reporting consistency, the same OC number must be reflected within Kiara’s system.
To achieve this, the following automation is proposed:
Once the OC number is confirmed by the user, the system shall automatically update the same OC number in the “Summary Buyer Order Ref” field.
The Summary Buyer Order Ref field shall:
• Be auto-populated
• Be visible across all transactions and reports of Kiara where the OC number is displayed.
Summary Buyer order Reference Screenshot
chunks.locator: § Section 3. Functional Requirements › CWT OC Number handling in Kiara

chunks.title: Section 4. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: Section 4. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• Shipment sample type order tagging
• The system shall display an “Order Type” dropdown field at the Additional Quantity Breakup (Line Level).
• The dropdown shall contain the following values:
• Shipment Sample
• Extra Production
• When Additional Quantity > 0, the Order Type field shall be mandatory.
• The system shall not allow the user to save the OC if:
• Additional Quantity is entered and
• Order Type is not selected.
• CWT OC Number Automation
• Upon confirmation of the OC number, the system shall automatically populate the OC number in the “Summary Buyer Order Ref” field.
